find.sql: SELECT "accounts"."id", "accounts"."display name", "accounts"."note", "accounts"."version", CAST("accounts"."mood" AS text) FROM "napi_entities"."accounts"

find-filtered.sql: SELECT "accounts"."id", "accounts"."display name", "accounts"."note", "accounts"."version", CAST("accounts"."mood" AS text) FROM "napi_entities"."accounts" WHERE "accounts"."id" >= $1 ORDER BY "accounts"."display name" DESC LIMIT $2

find-enum.sql: SELECT "accounts"."id", "accounts"."display name", "accounts"."note", "accounts"."version", CAST("accounts"."mood" AS text) FROM "napi_entities"."accounts" WHERE "accounts"."mood" = CAST($1::text AS napi_entities.mood)

find-one.sql: SELECT "accounts"."id", "accounts"."display name", "accounts"."note", "accounts"."version", CAST("accounts"."mood" AS text) FROM "napi_entities"."accounts" LIMIT $1

graph-notes.sql: SELECT "accounts"."id" AS "s0_id", "accounts"."display name" AS "s0_display name", "accounts"."note" AS "s0_note", "accounts"."version" AS "s0_version", CAST("accounts"."mood" AS text) AS "s0_mood", "n"."id" AS "s1_id", "n"."account_id" AS "s1_account_id", "n"."body" AS "s1_body" FROM "napi_entities"."accounts" LEFT JOIN "napi_entities"."notes" AS "n" ON "accounts"."id" = "n"."account_id"

graph-mixed-default-aliases.sql: SELECT "accounts"."id" AS "s0_id", "accounts"."display name" AS "s0_display name", "accounts"."note" AS "s0_note", "accounts"."version" AS "s0_version", CAST("accounts"."mood" AS text) AS "s0_mood", "g1"."id" AS "s1_id", "g1"."account_id" AS "s1_account_id", "g1"."body" AS "s1_body", "g2"."id" AS "s2_id", "g2"."account_id" AS "s2_account_id", "g2"."body" AS "s2_body" FROM "napi_entities"."accounts" INNER JOIN "napi_entities"."notes" AS "g1" ON "accounts"."id" = "g1"."account_id" LEFT JOIN "napi_entities"."notes" AS "g2" ON "accounts"."id" = "g2"."account_id"

graph-filtered.sql: SELECT "accounts"."id" AS "s0_id", "accounts"."display name" AS "s0_display name", "accounts"."note" AS "s0_note", "accounts"."version" AS "s0_version", CAST("accounts"."mood" AS text) AS "s0_mood", "n"."id" AS "s1_id", "n"."account_id" AS "s1_account_id", "n"."body" AS "s1_body" FROM "napi_entities"."accounts" LEFT JOIN "napi_entities"."notes" AS "n" ON "accounts"."id" = "n"."account_id" WHERE "n"."body" = $1 ORDER BY "accounts"."id" ASC
